claims: The 98th Academy Awards ceremony is scheduled to start on Sunday, March 15, 2026, at 7 p.m. ET / 4 p.m. PT.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony is hosted by Conan O'Brien.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony will broadcast live on ABC.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony will stream on Hulu.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony will be from the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles.
Red carpet coverage for the 98th Academy Awards ceremony starts at 3:30 p.m. ET / 12:30 p.m. PT.
